title: ContainmentProfiles
description:
`GET /v1/containment/profiles` on blackwall-serve — the profile registry,
read by reflexd when it queues a contained card. Not served yet.

digest.description: Digest over the whole registry document, for change detection.

enforced_tiers.description:
The isolation tiers serve ENFORCES and will attest (CER-2276 §6.1).
Containment is supported for tier T only when this lists T and some
profile's `tier` is T; reflexd refuses a contained submit otherwise
(`containment-not-enforced`). Absent parses as empty: a serve that
predates the field enforces nothing.

digest.description:
`"sha256:<hex>"` over the JCS form of the profile, computed by
blackwall. Copied into [`Containment::profile_digest`] verbatim.

profile.description:
The resolved profile as JSON text, verbatim as blackwall served it. Its
shape is blackwall's to define; soma reads only [`ProfileView`] out of
it and shows the rest to the signer unchanged.
